# Fixture

The `ADR-0134` form is quoted here in prose and cites nothing.

A fence is not a code span and stays checked, because CLAUDE.md requires the `NNNN`
placeholder for an illustrative number precisely so that a real one reads as a citation:

```
supersedes: [ADR-0888]
```

Link text stays checked, so [ADR-0001](adr/0001-alpha.md) still resolves.
